question: What sacred substances must be worn after marking the specified body locations?
premises: Sacred ash is to be applied as the tripuṇḍra mark.
Rudrākṣa beads are to be worn as a subsequent act.
These actions follow the prior marking of the specified body locations.
inference: After marking the specified body locations, one should apply the ash tripuṇḍra and then wear rudrākṣa beads.
plain_english: Having applied sacred ash as the three-lined mark, one should then wear rudrākṣa beads.
